title: Computer Numerically Controlled Tool Operators
description: Operate computer-controlled tools, machines, or robots to machine or process parts, tools, or other work pieces made of metal, plastic, wood, stone, or other materials. May also set up and maintain equipment.

tasks.text: Measure dimensions of finished workpieces to ensure conformance to specifications, using precision measuring instruments, templates, and fixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Set up and operate computer-controlled machines or robots to perform one or more machine functions on metal or plastic workpieces.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.

tasks.text: Mount, install, align, and secure tools, attachments, fixtures, and workpieces on machines, using hand tools and precision measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.
Install mechanical components in production equipment.

tasks.text: Review program specifications or blueprints to determine and set machine operations and sequencing, finished workpiece dimensions, or numerical control sequences.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.

tasks.text: Stop machines to remove finished workpieces or to change tooling, setup, or workpiece placement, according to required machining sequences.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Listen to machines during operation to detect sounds such as those made by dull cutting tools or excessive vibration, and adjust machines to compensate for problems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.

tasks.text: Implement changes to machine programs, and enter new specifications, using computers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Command entry often needs physical equipment interface

dwas.name: Enter commands, instructions, or specifications into equipment.
Program equipment to perform production tasks.

tasks.text: Calculate machine speed and feed ratios and the size and position of cuts.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Production requirement calc; human validates inputs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.

tasks.text: Transfer commands from servers to computer numerical control (CNC) modules, using computer network links.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Command entry often needs physical equipment interface

dwas.name: Enter commands, instructions, or specifications into equipment.

tasks.text: Remove and replace dull cutting tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Remove accessories, tools, or other parts from equipment.
Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Check to ensure that workpieces are properly lubricated and cooled during machine operation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Lubrication monitoring is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Monitor lubrication of equipment or workpieces.

tasks.text: Adjust machine feed and speed, change cutting tools, or adjust machine controls when automatic programming is faulty or if machines malfunction.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on production flow control

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.
Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.
Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Monitor machine operation and control panel displays, and compare readings to specifications to detect malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Command entry often needs physical equipment interface

dwas.name: Enter commands, instructions, or specifications into equipment.

tasks.text: Modify cutting programs to account for problems encountered during operation, and save modified programs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification
